tasks.label: diagnose-tomtom-403
tasks.command:
docker compose exec data-pipeline python -c "import os, requests; from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text; db=os.getenv('DB_CONNECTION_STRING'); key=os.getenv('TOMTOM_API_KEY',''); print('has_key=', bool(key), 'key_len=', len(key)); eng=create_engine(db); 
with eng.connect() as c:
  row=c.execute(text('SELECT ST_Y(geometry_center) AS lat, ST_X(geometry_center) AS lon FROM dim_segment WHERE geometry_center IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1')).mappings().first()
lat,lon=row['lat'],row['lon']
url='https://api.tomtom.com/traffic/services/4/flowSegmentData/absolute/10/json'
params={'key':key,'point':f'{lat},{lon}','unit':'KMPH'}
r=requests.get(url,params=params,timeout=15)
print('status=',r.status_code)
print('content_type=',r.headers.get('content-type'))
print('body=',r.text[:800])"
